scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=out/main/index.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/prepare-renderer.mjs && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:local && npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir .packaging --config ../electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release: npm run prepare:local && npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir .packaging --config ../electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish always
